TasteTable planner

AFTER YOUR WEEK

Your visit record

Keep what happened beside the original suggestions, one visit at a time.

Start with a saved week

In the planner or offline studio, choose Save week. Open that JSON file here, or reopen a visit record you saved earlier.

Files are read in this tab. Nothing is uploaded or stored automatically. Download a copy before leaving; it can include your notes and the original saved week. Do not include private health information.

Review this file

Using this file replaces the record shown below. Your current edits stay in place until you choose Use.

A record of your choices

Mark a visit as went, did not go, or leave it unrecorded. Add an optional date and what you would like to remember. Repeated suggestions remain separate visits.

ORIGINAL SAVED COPY

Your saved week

Original inputs and notes

    The original recommendations and checks have not been rerun. These are caregiver-entered outcomes, not reservations, venue verification, or medical or dietary advice.

    What happened

    Dates below are when the visit or decision happened. They may be outside the planned week. Notes and dates do not change the outcome.

    CSV is a tabular report of every original pick, including omitted and unrecorded visits. Import spreadsheet columns as text to preserve literal values. Keep the JSON file to reopen and edit.

    Undo or redo up to 20 visit edits in this tab. Using another file starts a new history.

      Keep the saved JSON file to continue later. This record does not change the original week, venue call sheet, calendar or future recommendations.
